tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Kirby Nightmare in dream Land for MultiWorld.
tutorials.text:
# Kirby Nightmare in Dream Land Setup Guide

Kirby Nightmare in Dreamland uses the common Bizhawk client connector, and so setup should be familiar to any players of other GBA AP games. 

## Required Software
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The Kirby Nightmare in Dream Land apworld](https://github.com/VizCount467/Kirby-NIDL-AP)
- Bizhawk emulator (version 2.7 or above)
- A US Kirby Nightmare in Dreamland ROM file

## Optional Software
- [Poptracker by Blakel](https://github.com/blakelmenakle/KNiDL-Poptracker)

### Configuring Bizhawk
- If you're using BizHawk 2.7 or 2.8, go to Config > Customize. On the Advanced tab, switch the Lua Core from NLua+KopiLua to Lua+LuaInterface, then restart EmuHawk. (If you're using BizHawk 2.9, you can skip this step.)

## Generating and Patching a Game
1. Create your options file (YAML). You can make by using "Generate Template Options" in the Archipelago Options.
2. Follow the general Archipelago instructions for generating a game. This will generate an output file for you. Your patch file will have the .apknidl file extension.
Open ArchipelagoLauncher.exe
3. Select "Open Patch" in the Archipelago Launcher and select your patch file. Alternatively, drag the .apknidl patch onto the AP launcher window, or simply open the patch file file itself with the Archieplago program
4. If this is your first time patching, you will be prompted to select your unmodified US Kirby Nightmare in Dream Land ROM.
5. A patched .gba file will be created in the same place as the patch file.
6. On your first time opening a patch with BizHawk Client, you will also be asked to locate EmuHawk.exe in your BizHawk install.

## Connecting to a Server
By default, opening a patch file will do steps 1-5 below for you automatically. Even so, this is good info to know if your session is disrupted for whatever reason.

1. Kirby Nightmare in Dream Land uses Archipelago's BizHawk Client. If the client isn't still open from when you patched your game, you can re-open it from the launcher.
2. Ensure EmuHawk is running the patched ROM.
  - The game may freeze on the GBA BIOS screen (console's intro logo/jingle). If this happens, set the "Skip BIOS" option to "True" in Emuhawk (Top menu GBA -> Settings).
3. In EmuHawk, go to Tools > Lua Console. This window must stay open while playing.
4. In the Lua Console window, go to Script > Open Script.
5. Navigate to your Archipelago install folder and open data/lua/connector_bizhawk_generic.lua.
6. The emulator and client will eventually connect to each other. The BizHawk Client window should indicate that it connected and recognized Kirby Nightmare in Dream Land.
7. To connect the client to the server, enter your room's address and port (e.g. archipelago.gg:38281, localhost:38247) into the top text field of the client and click Connect. 
  - Connection should be established on the in-game title screen or startup menu before starting a file - certain systems *will* break otherwise.

You should now be able to receive and send items. You'll need to do these steps every time you want to reconnect. Kirby Nightmare in Dreamland relies on the AP connection to send and receive items -- you cannot obtain any items without a connection, nor will any locations you check be reflected in the multiworld. Thus, playing without a connection is completely useless, and may cause certain systems to break.

readme.text:
# Kirby Nightmare in Dream Land Archipelago

Welcome to the Kirby Nightmare in Dreamland Archiepelago implementation. This game is fully playable, and development is ongoing with various planned features. The client is stable and the game is functional, but some undetected bugs may still exist. Please report any bugs/issues to [the AP Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1533318615057567885) in "future-game-design". 

## General Structure

All levels and doors are unlocked from the start, except for boss doors. You will not be able to enter boss doors until obtaining the required number of Star Rod Pieces. Collect all necessary Star Rod pieces and defeat Nightmare at the Fountain of Dreams to win. See [the guide in the docs](https://github.com/VizCount467/Kirby-NIDL-AP/blob/master/kirbynidl/docs/en_Kirby_Nightmare_in_Dream_Land.md) for more detailed game information and info on the configurable options. 

## Installation

Download the kirbynidl.apworld file from the latest GitHub release and install it by opening it in the Archipelago program or moving it into your "custom worlds" folder. From there, it should work the same as any other custom GBA AP game. 

See the [setup file in the docs](https://github.com/VizCount467/Kirby-NIDL-AP/blob/master/kirbynidl/docs/setup_en.md) for complete details.
Also check out the [Poptracker by Blakel](https://github.com/blakelmenakle/KNiDL-Poptracker), if interested. 

## Features Currently Implemented

- Locations
    - All level clears
    - All world bosses
    - All in-level consumable items (Pep Drinks, 1ups, Candy, Maxim Tomatoes)
    - All Big Switches
    - All Arenas

- Items
    - Consumable Pickups (Pep Drinks, 1ups, Maxim Tomatoes, Invincibility Candy)
        - Health items are not awarded immediately, but added to a "Bank". HP is automatically restored from the bank as you take damage.
        - Consumable items are single-use. If you quit and re-open the same save file on the same saved game, you will not receive items received during the last session (the HP bank also resets)
    - Star Rod Pieces - unlocks world Boss and next world
    - Unlock Copy Abilities 
    - Unlock Minigames (Bomb Rally, Air Grind, Quick Draw) and other bonus doors (Arena, Museum, Warp Station) for each world
        - NOTE: Doors that are NOT locked behind big switches in the vanilla game, ie the World 1 Museum, start as locked. All possible doors are shuffled in!
    - Vitality (Max HP Upgrades) - currently fixed at 3 upgrades with 3 Max HP to start, configurable in the options
        - Vitality pieces also affect the amount of HP you get from consumables. 

- Options
    - Variable number of existing and required Star Rod Pieces
    - Variable starting health and number of health upgrades
    - Start with all Copy Abilities and/or bonus doors unlocked, if desired
    - Toggle obscure/difficult tricks in location logic
    - Skip Bosses with the Warp Star Station and play Worlds out of order
    - Death Link!

## Features Planned To be Implemented
- Enemy ability shuffle

## Speculative Features

- Locations
    - Win minigames in specific worlds
- Items
    - Unlock individual levels (complicates ability logic)
- Kirby Palette changer (implemented in other randomizers of the game)
- Level and/or World Shuffle (complicates ability logic)
- Option to play as Meta Knight (Kirby still plays the final boss? Stop at Dedede?)
- Trap items (Sleep Trap, Explosion Trap...)
- Energy Link Support
- On-Screen AP Text (via either the nightmare defeated story narration or the label that appears at the top of the screen in each overworld lobby) (maybe the credits too??)

## Known Bugs and Issues

- The game may crash at the GBA BIOS. Set Bizhawk to skip the BIOS if this is a problem for you.
- Getting grabbed by certain midbosses with invincibility active may still hurt Kirby (and can make the invincibility theme play until the next room)
- The interaction of savestates and the various client-dependent game interactions is completely unknown -- use save states at your own risk!

## Latest Updates (See Releases for Full Changelog)

- 10/7/26: 
    - Added Death Link!
    - Added Overworld door color manipulation to indicate completion (flashing red if a level has unchecked locations, yellow for full clear)
    - Items have their vanilla effects when collected a second time after a reset, to help with replaying levels. 
    - Added the "Kirby actionable" IWRAM flag to client and ASM actions (will help prevent crashes, probably)
    - Fixed the starting vitality option not working and defaulting to 3
- 10/8/26:
    - Fixed bug in hijacked healing routine where the Kirby "actionable" flag wasn't being reset
- 10/14/26:
    - Added client "starrod" and "abilities" command
    - Updated docs with BIOS crash note, poptracker links
    - Fixed client not receiving starting inventory
    - Added Warp Station skips to Options, Tests, and gen logic (no client yet though)
- 10/21/26
    - Updated Logic for Crash lighting fuses and 7-5 Cannon with Burning
    - Added additional "hp" and "doors" commands
    - Added Warp Station skips to client (tested)
    - Some function-based abstraction/reformatting of client.py
- 10/23/26
    - Final prep for 0.0.2 release
    - Fixed bug where "locked door names" was being initialized as a list and not a set
    - Fixed Warp Station Skips + Bonus Doors option putting (nearly) entire game in sphere 1 (probably)
- 11/2/26
    - Begin building enemy ability shuffle (rules need finalizing, no patching yet)
    - Fix UFO logic for 2-3 1up
    - Updated 7-5 Cannon logic again to require Fire AND Burning on normal logic (so the Player can use their preference)


## Credits and Shout-Outs

- Thanks to the RetroAchievements community for getting me started with their RAM map documentation
- Thanks to aquova and their [KNDL-Rando Repo](https://github.com/Aquova/KNDL-Rando) for additional RAM mapping and initial draft of an ability-locking system. 
- Thanks to fellow GBA APWorld devs brodieberger ([Mega Man Zero 3](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago)) and lilDavid ([Wario Land 4](https://github.com/lilDavid/Archipelago-Wario-Land-4)). Many structures and concepts from their code were studied and utilized in this project.
- Thanks to the Kirby Wiki for listing out the enemies in each and every level, with KA vs KNiDL differences!

notes.text:
This is a small release that adds two new features.

### Warp Station Skips 
With this option enabled, you can skip bosses and play worlds out of order if you find Warp Station keys. This results in a less linear experience, and is great for players that want to shake their run up (before I make level shuffle, at least). 

### Commands
Four new client commands have been added that allow you to check your received items and game status without consulting a tracker.
- `/starrod`: displays info about current Star Rod Piece progression, required Pieces to Goal, and the target for the next Boss Door. 
- `/abilities`: lists all currently unlocked copy abilities
- `/hp`: lists current HP in reserve and the HP values of incoming food items
- `/doors`: lists all currently unlocked overworld Bonus Doors, ordered by World

Client.py code has been abstracted/streamlined slightly under the hood

## Full Changelog
- 10/14/26:
    - Added client "starrod" and "abilities" command
    - Updated docs with BIOS crash note, poptracker links
    - Fixed client not receiving starting inventory
    - Added Warp Station skips to Options, Tests, and gen logic (no client yet though)

    - Added additional "hp" and "doors" commands
    - Added Warp Station skips to client (tested)
    - Some function-based abstraction/reformatting of client.py
- 10/23/26
    - Final prep for 0.0.2 release
    - Fixed bug where "locked door names" was being initialized as a list and not a set
    - Fixed Warp Station Skips + Bonus Doors option putting (nearly) entire game in sphere 1 (probably)
